outputs.explanation: Body weight, LW/BW, and FW/BW are shown as scatter plots with individual data points (dots/squares) for each animal, plus mean ± S.D. bars.
Panel B shows representative gross photographs of mice, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel C shows representative H&E and Oil Red O micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a dot blot (5mC) and methylene blue staining image, not a plot of averaged data.
The 5mC/Methylene Blue quantification bar chart displays individual data points (dots) for each sample overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars.
The top part is a western blot (not a plot); the bottom bar chart quantifying TET1/TET2/TET3 ratios shows individual data points overlaid on the mean ± S.D. bars.
